title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes
summary: A dataset, toolkit, and benchmark for grounding task-specific functional elements and affordance regions inside 3D scenes.

mechanisms.name: Task-specific functional-element annotations
mechanisms.description: Represents a scene object through the fine-grained part that performs a requested function, rather than treating the parent object bounding box as the action target.
mechanisms.limitations: Dataset supervision and benchmark performance do not establish zero-shot transfer, phone-camera reliability, exact-instance identity, navigation completion, or user benefit.
